name: AssistanceProvision
definition: An event within an HLJ Stage Execution in which assistance specified for that stage is provided.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: AssistanceSpecification
definition: A Normative Description of support intended to be made available within an HLJ Stage Specification.

name: ChallengeEncounter
definition: An event within an HLJ Stage Execution in which the specified challenge of that stage is faced, whether or not it is successfully addressed.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: ChallengePerformance
definition: An event within an HLJ Stage Execution in which action is directed towards the specified challenge of that stage; its occurrence does not by itself imply success.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: ChallengeSpecification
definition: A Normative Description assigned to a Stage Specification that describes a demand, obstacle, problem, task, or condition that makes progression demanding.

name: ClosureSituation
definition: A situation brought about by a Journey Execution that satisfies a Closure Specification; in a successful execution, that specification is defined by the executed model.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: ClosureSpecification
definition: A Condition Description defined by a Journey Model that states the condition under which an execution of the model counts as having reached closure.

name: ConditionDescription
definition: A Normative Description that specifies a condition against which a situation can be assessed.

name: Description
definition: An Information Object that expresses a conceptualization of entities or configurations and provides criteria for interpreting or assessing them.

name: EducationalPurpose
definition: A Goal Description that states an educational aim of a Learning Journey Model.

name: GoalDescription
definition: A Normative Description whose propositional content describes a situation intended to be attained.

name: HeroicNarrativeJourneyExecution
definition: A Narrative Journey Execution of a Heroic Narrative Journey Model that constitutes one focal heroic trajectory with exactly one Protagonist.

name: HeroicNarrativeJourneyModel
definition: A Narrative Journey Model that frames a meaningful progression through demanding stages towards transformation and closure as a heroic trajectory.

name: HeroicNarrativeLearningJourneyExecution
definition: A Heroic Narrative Journey Execution and Learning Journey Execution of one Heroic Narrative Learning Journey Model, with exactly one focal Person participating as both Protagonist and Learner.

name: HeroicNarrativeLearningJourneyModel
definition: A Heroic Narrative Journey Model and Learning Journey Model whose identity includes one Journey Narrative, at least two connected Stage Specifications, at least one challenged stage, at least one Educational Purpose, at least one Intended Learning Transformation, and one Closure Specification.

name: HLJStageExecution
definition: A Stage Execution of an HLJ Stage Specification that may include Challenge Encounters, Challenge Performances, and Assistance Provisions connected to specifications of that same stage.

name: HLJStageSpecification
definition: A Stage Specification and Plan Description in the Heroine's Learning Journey anatomy that contains exactly one Narrative Framing, Mission Specification, Challenge Specification, and Assistance Specification.

name: InformationObject
definition: An entity whose identity is determined by its informational content and that may be expressed through different physical or digital carriers.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: IntendedLearningTransformation
definition: An Intended Transformation that specifies a learning-related change to be pursued through a learning journey.

name: IntendedTransformation
definition: A Goal Description prescribed by a Journey Model that specifies a transformation the model is intended to bring about.

name: JourneyExecution
definition: A complex event in which one Journey Model is enacted in a particular context through one or more Stage Executions.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: JourneyModel
definition: A Description that characterises a reusable journey pattern through one or more Stage Specifications and one Closure Specification, and may prescribe Intended Transformations.

name: JourneyNarrative
definition: Narrative Content that organises the narrative progression of a Narrative Journey Model as a whole.

name: Learner
definition: A historical role instantiated by a Person through participation in a Learning Journey Execution.

name: LearningJourneyExecution
definition: A Journey Execution of a Learning Journey Model in which at least one Person participates as Learner.

name: LearningJourneyModel
definition: A Journey Model and Plan Description that intentionally organises an educational experience and has at least one Educational Purpose.

name: MissionSpecification
definition: A Normative Description that states what the Learner is invited or expected to pursue within an HLJ stage and may combine a desired result with directions for action.

name: NarrativeContent
definition: An Information Object that organises characters, events, or themes as narrative content, independently of the medium through which it is expressed.

name: NarrativeFraming
definition: Narrative Content that gives one HLJ Stage Specification its local narrative context and connects it to the wider journey.

name: NarrativeJourneyExecution
definition: A Journey Execution of a Narrative Journey Model in which the performed stages enact a narratively organised journey.

name: NarrativeJourneyModel
definition: A Journey Model whose overall progression is organised by exactly one Journey Narrative.

name: NormativeDescription
definition: A Description that prescribes, permits, or evaluates possible actions or situations instead of merely characterising them.

name: Person
definition: A human individual who may participate in Journey Executions and whose identity is preserved across the historical roles Protagonist and Learner.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: PlanDescription
definition: A Normative Description that prescribes or organises intended actions and events towards a purpose.

name: Protagonist
definition: A historical role instantiated by a Person through participation as the focal subject of a Heroic Narrative Journey Execution.

name: RealizedTransformation
definition: A situation brought about by one or more Transformation Events that represents an actual change concerning exactly one Person and satisfies one Intended Transformation.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: StageExecution
definition: An event within a Journey Execution that enacts one Stage Specification belonging to the executed Journey Model.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.

name: StageSpecification
definition: A Description that characterises a model-specific stage of a Journey Model, whether as a descriptive pattern or as a prescribed part of a plan, and may be linked to other Stage Specifications through directlyPrecedesStage.

name: SuccessfulHeroicNarrativeLearningJourneyExecution
definition: A Heroic Narrative Learning Journey Execution that produces a Closure Situation satisfying the executed model's Closure Specification and at least one Realized Transformation of the focal Person satisfying an Intended Learning Transformation prescribed by that model.

name: TransformationEvent
definition: An event within a Journey Execution that brings about one Realized Transformation.
detail: Top-level type in the OntoJourney domain model.
